answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that thaws as slowly as a glacier: one stake per identity, slashed on proven fraud. New identities start on an island of zero trust - no history, no work - and must earn reputation through small verified jobs before touching real value, climbing a knoll of trust one completed task at a time. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes plus weeks of honest work each, while one real agent pays once.
